text: The slot holds the head `prototypes + sentences` for `bioclip2-l14` (species_sci, beta 8, bias for species without photos 0.65), fitted on `images/alachua-2025 (two thirds of val)`, with 5911 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `product`, t_kind 20, w_kind 0.5, alpha_prior 0.6. On 565 tuning photos (the third of val kept for tuning) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.05 and offer_at never (no level reached nine in ten). On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 98.6% (98.2 to 98.9); the top species is right for 91.7% (90.9 to 92.6) and is among the first five for 97.6% (97.1 to 98.0). `person` was said for 0.00% of these photos and `none` for 0.00%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind phrases`. With kind_at 0.90 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 54.4% (52.9 to 55.9) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 99.8% (99.6 to 100.0) of those; for the 45.6% (44.1 to 47.1) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 99.0% (98.5 to 99.4). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds`), the kind is right for 15.6% (13.5 to 17.7); the page asserts a kind for 5.0% (3.8 to 6.3) and is right for 98.4% (95.2 to 100.0) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 19.9% (17.7 to 22.2). A species is named on 5.0% (3.8 to 6.3) of these photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
